talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $279.8M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, up 62% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was CU WealthNext, LLC (Frankenmuth, Other Banking and Financial Services) targeting $35M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
O2 Auto Service Holdings, LLC disclosed a deal. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan private funds assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

4 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $262.5M raised so far — led by Nantucket Fund L P (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
